verdict.rationale: Hightouch Events documents an HTTP Tracking API for server-side ingestion, including a batch endpoint, so the core server-to-server path exists. The bearer-token authentication evidence belongs to the separate management REST API for syncs and models, so it does not transfer to event ingestion. Nothing in the pack covers delivery guarantees. Missing for 10: documented authentication for the events HTTP API, delivery guarantees (retries, acknowledgements, at-least-once semantics, idempotency), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I can send events server-to-server through a documented HTTP ingestion API with authentication and delivery guarantees

citations.quote: plus an HTTP API for server-side ingestion
Hightouch's HTTP Tracking API enables you to record data from any website or application.
Use the batch endpoint to submit multiple events to the collector in a single request.
You instrument your app, site, or backend with a Hightouch SDK, the HTTP API, or a streaming source like Kafka or Google Pub/Sub.
